newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian bond curve flattens, longs outpace.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian bond curve flattens, longs outpace.

text.p: The Australian bond yield curve flattened following comments by Reserve Bank governor Ian Macfarlance on Tuesday which indicated that monetary policy was on hold at 6.0 percent.

The three/10-year bond futures spread dropped to its lowest level since end-December as hopes of an easing were further unwound with the curve having already taken a hammering last week following strong wages data for the November quarter.
However, local long bonds shrugged off the gloom of the short end and built on Tuesday's post-tender rally and outpaced the dollar bloc.

The U.S. faces the second stage of the quarterly refunding auctions with the sale of US12.0 billion of 10-year notes, while Canadian bonds also have to absorb C$2.3 billion of bonds in the same maturity.
New Zealand bond yields ended a slow session higher.
